resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO
resources.notes: Open-source DFT code; version 6.x or later recommended.

resources.name: ABINIT
resources.notes: Alternative open-source DFT code, particularly suited for DFPT phonon calculations. Not mandatory if QE is used.

resources.name: Pseudopotential libraries (SSSP/PseudoDojo/HGH)
resources.notes: For Quantum ESPRESSO: SSSP precision or PseudoDojo libraries. For ABINIT: HGH pseudopotentials. Any standard LDA pseudopotentials yielding comparable results are acceptable.

resources.name: Python scientific stack (numpy, scipy, matplotlib)
resources.notes: For equation-of-state fitting and data analysis.
